podcast.body: Maintains a highly interesting Instagram profile, considered by some to be among the most engaging to follow personally. "tiene unos de los instagramos más interesantes a los que sigo yo personalmente como usuario."

podcast.title: Poetic Computation Exhibition (Sónar Festival)
podcast.body: Lieberman presented an exhibition at the Sónar Festival, showcasing his pioneering work in plastic arts. He is recognized internationally, a professor at "Villa Sartes" (likely a school of arts), featured in Time magazine, and a recipient of numerous awards for using AI, AR, and VR as artistic expression methods to create interactive and sometimes unpredictable "living structures" through projections and video creations. "Fue uno de los momentos más interesantes yo creo que del sonar, porque daba un poco esa vertintartística y sobre todo una vertintartística bastante distinta de la que solemos tener muy interactiva con el usuario."
